blueprint.source: NDA Paper II GAT: 150 questions, 600 marks, 150 minutes; English 50, GK 100; negative 1/3.

questions.text: The capital city of Australia is located on which continent?
questions.solution: The capital of Australia, Canberra, is located on the continent of Australia. Africa contains Cairo, Europe contains Brussels, and Asia contains New Delhi.

questions.text: Select the word that best completes the sentence: 'The committee will meet _____ to discuss the new policy.'
questions.solution: 'Tomorrow' is the only future-time adverb suitable for a scheduled event involving 'will'. 'Yesterday', 'next week', and 'last month' do not fit logically as 'will' indicates immediate or near future intent in this context, while 'yesterday' and 'last month' are past times.

questions.text: The river Narmada flows through a rift valley and drains into which major water body?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the 'West Flowing = Arabian Sea' rule for Peninsular rivers. Only Narmada and Tapi (major rivers) flow West through rift valleys into the Arabian Sea (Gulf of Khambhat). All other major Peninsular rivers (Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Kaveri) flow East into Bay of Bengal. Step-by-step: Narmada originates at Amarkantak (Maikal Hills). It flows Westwards between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges (rift valley). It forms an estuary at the Gulf of Khambhat, which is an inlet of the Arabian Sea.

questions.text: Night blindness (Nyctalopia) is caused by the deficiency of which vitamin?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Mnemonic/Function mapping. Vitamin A = Vision (Retina/Rhodopsin). Vitamin C = Scurvy (Collagen). Vitamin D = Rickets/Osteomalacia (Calcium absorption). Vitamin B1 = Beriberi (Nerve/Heart). 'Night' blindness links directly to 'A' for 'Aye' (Eye). Worked Solution: Vitamin A (Retinol) is a component of rhodopsin, the photopigment in rod cells of the retina essential for low-light (scotopic) vision. Its deficiency impairs rhodopsin regeneration, leading to night blindness. Prolonged deficiency causes xerophthalmia and keratomalacia.

questions.text: An element with atomic number 18 belongs to which group and period of the modern periodic table?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Write electronic configuration for Z=18: 2, 8, 8. Number of shells (3) = Period Number. Valence electrons (8) = Group Number (for noble gases, Group 18). Step-by-step: Atomic Number 18 implies 18 electrons. Distribution: K-shell (2), L-shell (8), M-shell (8). Since there are 3 shells occupied, the Period is 3. Since the outermost shell has 8 electrons (complete octet), it is a noble gas belonging to Group 18. The element is Argon (Ar).

questions.text: Identify the synonym of the word 'Lucid'.
questions.solution: 'Lucid' means clear, easy to understand, or rational. 'Clear' is a direct synonym. The other options—'confusing', 'obscure', and 'vague'—are antonyms that describe something difficult to understand.

questions.text: Under which Article of the Constitution of India can the President proclaim a National Emergency on grounds of war, external aggression, or armed rebellion?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Memorize the Emergency Article series (Part XVIII): 352 = National Emergency; 356 = State Emergency (President's Rule); 360 = Financial Emergency. Article 365 deals with failure to comply with Union directions (consequence leads to Art 356). Step-by-step: Part XVIII (Articles 352-360) contains Emergency Provisions. Article 352(1) explicitly states: 'If the President is satisfied that a grave emergency exists whereby the security of India or any part of the territory thereof is threatened, whether by war or external aggression or armed rebellion, he may... make a declaration...'.

questions.text: Identify the antonym of the word 'Benevolent'.
questions.solution: 'Benevolent' means well-meaning and kindly. 'Malevolent' means wishing harm on others, making it the direct antonym. 'Kind', 'Generous', and 'Helpful' are synonyms or related positive traits.

questions.text: Identify the part of speech for the word 'Solemnly'.
questions.solution: 'Solemnly' ends in '-ly' and modifies a verb (e.g., spoke solemnly), indicating it is an adverb describing manner. 'Noun', 'Adjective', and 'Verb' are incorrect classifications for this word form.

questions.text: The SI unit of pressure is:
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use dimensional elimination. Newton (N) is Force (kg m/s²), Joule (J) is Work/Energy (kg m²/s²), Watt (W) is Power (kg m²/s³). Pressure is Force/Area (N/m²), which is uniquely defined as Pascal (Pa). Worked Solution: Pressure (P) = Force (F) / Area (A). SI unit of Force is Newton (N), SI unit of Area is m². Therefore, unit of Pressure = N/m². This derived unit is given the special name Pascal (Pa). 1 Pa = 1 N/m² = 1 kg/(m·s²).

questions.text: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: 'The _____ of the project has been delayed until next month.'
questions.solution: 'Implementation' refers to the process of putting a plan or project into effect. If a project is 'delayed', it usually refers to the start of its execution (implementation). 'Inception' refers to the very beginning idea, while 'termination' and 'suspension' imply stopping or ending the project, which contradicts the idea of a delay in progress towards completion.

questions.text: Which planet in our solar system is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.solution: Mars appears red due to iron oxide (rust) prevalent on its surface. Venus is known as the Morning Star or Evening Star due to its brightness. Jupiter is the largest planet with a Great Red Spot but is not called the Red Planet generally. Saturn is famous for its prominent ring system.

questions.text: Which of the following physical quantities has the SI unit 'Joule per Second'?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Remember the definition of Watt: 1 Watt = 1 Joule/Second. Power is defined as the rate of doing work (Work/Time). Since Work is measured in Joules and Time in Seconds, the unit of Power is Joule per Second (Watt). Force is kg m/s² (Newton), Work/Energy is Joule, Pressure is N/m² (Pascal). Step-by-step: Unit of Work = Joule (J). Unit of Time = Second (s). Power = Work / Time = J / s. This derived unit is named Watt (W).

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for Gold?
questions.solution: The chemical symbol for Gold is Au (from Latin 'Aurum'). Ag is the symbol for Silver, Fe stands for Iron, and Cu represents Copper.

questions.text: Which of the following is the primary source of legislation in India?
questions.solution: The Parliament of India is the supreme legislative body responsible for making laws. The President gives assent to bills but does not originate them independently; the Supreme Court interprets laws rather than creating them; and the Prime Minister leads the executive branch without direct law-making power.
